opening.argument: The presentation directs participants into a sponsor-linked Bitcoin-mining network rather than offering only a neutral registration tutorial. It makes sponsor registration a condition, stating that “you must register with your sponsor,” and explains that partners who pass through a personal link can be tracked, with “all the email addresses of your partners, whom have passed through your link, will be displayed.” The financial purpose is explicit: participants are told that “you can make money for the Bitcoin Club Network membership.” Alongside the description’s claim that the club “actually mines the most expensive currency in the world - Bitcoin,” these instructions connect membership earnings to sponsor-based recruitment and partner tracking.
